name: HZ_GEO_ZONES_INT
description: HZ_GEOGRAPHIES_INT is an interface table to load data to TCA zones data into tables such as HZ_GEOGRAPHIES, HZ_GEOGRAPHY_IDENTIFIERS ,HZ_RELATIONSHIPS and HZ_GEOGRAPHY_RANGES.This table is used for High Volume import.

columns.name: BATCH_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier for a geography zones import batch.

columns.name: INTERFACE_ROW_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier for this interface record. (internal use only)

columns.name: ZONE_NAME
columns.description: Name of the zone

columns.name: ZONE_CODE
columns.description: Code of the zone.

columns.name: ZONE_TYPE
columns.description: Type of the zone.

columns.name: ZONE_TIMEZONE_CODE
columns.description: Time zone of the geography zone (Foreign key to FND_TIMEZONES_B.TIMZONE_CODE)

columns.name: ZONE_START_DATE
columns.description: Start date from which this zone is valid for use.

columns.name: ZONE_END_DATE
columns.description: Date from which this zone is no longer valid.

columns.name: ZONE_GEOGRAPHY_USE
columns.description: Usage of geography data. Value is from lookup type ORA_HZ_GEO_USAGE. Sample values are MASTER_REF, ORA_COMPENSATION, SHIPPING, TM, etc.

columns.name: ZONE_GEOGRAPHY_ID
columns.description: Unique Identifier of the Zone Geography created.

columns.name: MASTER_GEOGRAPHY_ID
columns.description: Unique geography identifier used in TCA geography tables (internal use only).

columns.name: MASTER_GEO_COUNTRY_CODE
columns.description: Country code of the Master geography record.

columns.name: MASTER_GEO_NAME
columns.description: Name of the master geography record.

columns.name: MASTER_GEO_TYPE
columns.description: Geography Type of the master geography record.

columns.name: MASTER_GEO_LEVEL
columns.description: Geography Level of the master geography record.

columns.name: MASTER_GEO_ELEMENT1
columns.description: Hierarchy of geography of the zone record.

columns.name: MASTER_GEO_ELEMENT2
columns.description: Hierarchy of geography of the zone record.

columns.name: MASTER_GEO_ELEMENT3
columns.description: Hierarchy of geography of the zone record.

columns.name: MASTER_GEO_ELEMENT4
columns.description: Hierarchy of geography of the zone record.

columns.name: MASTER_GEO_ELEMENT5
columns.description: Hierarchy of geography of the zone record.

columns.name: MASTER_GEO_ELEMENT6
columns.description: Hierarchy of geography of the zone record.

columns.name: MASTER_GEO_ELEMENT7
columns.description: Hierarchy of geography of the zone record.

columns.name: MASTER_GEO_ELEMENT8
columns.description: Hierarchy of geography of the zone record

columns.name: MASTER_GEO_ELEMENT9
columns.description: Hierarchy of geography of the zone record

columns.name: ZONE_RELATIONSHIP_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the relationship record created for the zone.

columns.name: RELATIONSHIP_START_DATE
columns.description: Start Date of the Relationship

columns.name: RELATIONSHIP_END_DATE
columns.description: End Date of the Relationship.

columns.name: GEOGRAPHY_RANGE_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the Geography range record.

columns.name: FROM_POSTAL_CODE
columns.description: Postal Code from which the zone starts.

columns.name: TO_POSTAL_CODE
columns.description: Postal Code till which the zone ends.

columns.name: POSTAL_CODE_START_DATE
columns.description: Start date active of the Postal Code geography record

columns.name: POSTAL_CODE_END_DATE
columns.description: End date active of the Postal Code geography record.

columns.name: GEOGRAPHY_IDENTIFIER_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier for a geography in HZ_GEOGRAPHY_IDENTIFIERS table (internal use only)

columns.name: ZONE_COUNTRY_CODE
columns.description: Country Code of the zone created.

columns.name: LANGUAGE_CODE
columns.description: Stores the language in which identifier_value is stored. (Foreign key to FND_ LANGUAGES.LANGUAGE_CODE)

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: FILE_RECORD_NUM
columns.description: Import framework uses this column to relate records in this interface table to rows in a file. (internal use only)

columns.name: IMPORT_STATUS_CODE
columns.description: Import framework uses this status: I - In Progress,  O - Obsolete(This would be the status of all the interface table records that were run before),  E - Errored, S - Successful (internal use only)

columns.name: FILE_NAME_SYSTASK_ID
columns.description: Stores systask id for each import csv file.

columns.name: INTERNAL_ACTION_CODE
columns.description: Indicates the action of insert(I),delete(D) or update(U) for internal use.

columns.name: ACTION_CODE
columns.description: Indicates the action code set by import flow.
